title: Register for the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate
summary: Learn how to register for the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate to claim back the value of tolls used on the M5 South-West Motorway.
intro:
The M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate allows NSW residents that use the M5 South-West Motorway to claim back the value of tolls (excluding GST).

After you receive confirmation that you have registered you can Claim the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate.
who_can_apply: Must have a vehicle registered in NSW for private, pensioner, or charitable use
Must have a toll account (tag or tagless) with a NSW provider
what_you_need: A NSW toll account (tag or tagless) with a NSW provider

how_to_steps.text: open a toll account with a NSW toll provider and follow the prompts during the set-up process
log in to your existing toll provider account and update your preferences

more_info.text: Your eligibility for the rebate starts from the first day of the month in which you registered.
Your vehicle may be photographed at M5 South-West toll points for audit purposes.

internal_links.text: Claim the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate

faqs.q: What is the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme rebate?
faqs.a: The rebate allows NSW residents who use the M5 South-West Motorway to claim back the value of tolls (excluding GST).

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the rebate?
faqs.a: You must be a NSW resident, have a vehicle registered in NSW for private, pensioner, or charitable use, and have a toll account (tag or tagless) with a NSW provider.

faqs.q: How do I register for the rebate?
faqs.a: You must open a toll account with a NSW toll provider, log in to your existing toll provider account to update your preferences, and then contact your toll provider.
